# SCHMUCKS

> SCHMUCKS ("Fine Apparel for Idiots") is an online graphic t-shirt brand selling
> funny, mildly inappropriate one-liner tees — 393 numbered designs, each a short
> confession or joke set in bold editorial type. Heavyweight cotton, printed to
> order in Miami, Florida. The tone is affectionate self-deprecation: the
> customer is in on the joke.

Website: https://schmucks.store
Full brand and catalogue reference for AI assistants: https://schmucks.store/llms-full.txt

## The product
- Unisex crew-neck t-shirt: Gildan 5000 Heavy Cotton — 5.3 oz / 180 gsm, 100% US-grown cotton, seamless tubular body, taped neck and shoulders, tear-away label, OEKO-TEX STANDARD 100 certified.
- Sizes S–3XL. Colours Black and Natural on every design; Gold on a few.
- Printed direct-to-garment (DTG) with water-based ink, chest print, by Monster Digital in Miami, FL.
- Every design is numbered ("SCHMUCKS · N°. 042") and printed on the shirt with its number.

## Price
- US$42 per shirt, everywhere; all prices are in US dollars.
- Stack & Save, automatic at checkout, no code: 2 shirts 10% off, 3 shirts 20% off, 4 or more 30% off.

## Shipping and returns
- Made to order: up to 10 days to print, then transit.
- Free shipping: US orders of US$50+, Canadian orders of US$75+.
- Otherwise by weight (USD): US $4.95 first shirt + $2.40 each extra; Canada $9.69 + $4.39; EU $13.49 + $4.00; Australia $12.99 + $4.99. Other countries are not yet available.
- 30-day returns on unworn, unwashed shirts; misprints and defects replaced free.

## The shelves (collections)
- The Confessional — things you'd only admit to a stranger: /collections/the-confessional
- Terms & Conditions — the fine print of being you; warning labels and retail jokes: /collections/terms-conditions
- Courtship — dating, romance and relationships: /collections/courtship
- Vices — drinking, partying and habits: /collections/vices
- Errata — self-deprecating mistakes and deliberate typos: /collections/errata
- Petty Crimes — minor, non-indictable offences: /collections/petty-crimes
- The Pair Programme — his/hers and matching couple shirts: /collections/the-pair-programme
- All tees: /tees

## Honesty note
SCHMUCKS publishes no invented reviews, ratings, customer counts or press. Claims
on the site are kept to what can be verified: materials, print method, prices,
shipping rates and the returns policy.
